findings.description: The regex check was changed from `match.match(...)` to `match.fullmatch(...)`. This alters semantics beyond the stated goal of accepting an empty message.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `retry_if_exception_message(match="foo")` with an exception message of "foo bar". Before the change, `re.match` matched the prefix and the call retried. Now `fullmatch` requires the whole string to match, so it does not retry. Existing users who rely on prefix matching see silently changed retry behavior.
